rows.en:
You fight kind of like
Hilda-sensei, you know.

R-really?
I wasn't even trying to...

Okay then, now let's see your
technique, Kagura-kun!

(I came to the artificial island
with Yuuto today.)

Great weather, huh,
\p?
Yeah, it's a perfect day for the beach.
The beach?

Today's the marathon around the island,
isn't it?

Wha-, nobody told me that!!
Isn't this supposed to be a vacation?!
Whew, that sure was tiring.
I-I can't move anymore...

I'm impressed you kept up with me.
I really picked up the pace
in the second half, too.

Well, since we came all this way,
let's eat something tasty
before we head home.
(...Today was a nice change of pace.)

(I came to the artificial island
with Kagura-kun today.)
Yeah, a perfect day for the beach!
(...Today was a nice change of pace.)

(I came to the artificial island
with Yuuto again today.)

Great weather as always, huh,
\p?

Yeah, every day's a perfect day
for the beach.

You're still saying that...?
It's another marathon today, isn't it?
I-I knew it...

Man, getting your body moving
really feels great, doesn't it?
Well, I feel sick...

I'm impressed you kept up with me again.
I really picked up the pace
right from the start, too.
You think so?

Well, since we came all this way,
let's grab something tasty to drink
before we head home.

(I came to the artificial island
with Kagura-kun again today.)

Yeah, every day's a perfect day
for the beach.
Well, I feel sick...
(...Today was a nice change of pace.)

(I came to Deep Akihabara
with Yuuto today.)

So this is Deep Akihabara.
Do you come here often?

Not on my own, I guess.
Just now and then with friends.

I don't know anything about this place,
so could you show me around?
Roger~
This town really does have everything.

Yeah.
But what would anyone do with
a police light sold all by itself?

Who knows?
Build a police car, maybe...
No, an ambulance?

Either way, it's a fascinating town.
Let's look around a bit more.

(I came to Deep Akihabara
with Kagura-kun today.)

Not on my own, I guess.
Just every once in a while with friends.

(I'm going to Deep Akihabara
with Yuuto again today.)
Sorry, did I keep you waiting?
Nah, I just got here myself.
Well then, shall we take a stroll?
I ended up buying it on impulse, but...

What are you even going to use
a police light for?

Good question...
Maybe I should try building an alarm
or something?

Either way, even after walking around
all day, there's still so much
I don't understand about this place.
But let's come again sometime.

(I'm going to Deep Akihabara
with Kagura-kun again today.)

What are you even going to use
a police light for...?

(I'm going to a concert
with Yuuto today.)
You're late, \p.

Sorry, sorry.
I kind of overslept...

Were you that excited about the concert?
Come on, you're not a little kid.
That's not really it, but...

Well, let's not waste any time.
Shall we go?

That was my first time hearing
classical music live, but...

The sheer power of the sound
blew me away...

It hit me as hard as the first time
I flew a Valkyrie...
Haah... I want to come again...

(I'm going to a concert
with Kagura-kun today.)
That's not really it, but...

I was totally overwhelmed
by the power of it...

(I came to a concert with Yuuto
again today.)
\p, I can't wait!

Y-yeah...
But you shouldn't get too rowdy...

I know, but...
There's no way I can hold back
this excitement!

...I kind of envy you, Yuuto,
getting that pumped up over
a classical concert...
All right, the doors open any minute now!

Ahh, classical music truly is
a wonderful thing, isn't it...

Y-Yuuto...
You've turned into a different person...
That's how wonderful it is!

Honestly, how can you stay so calm?
Listen, starting with that opening......

(I came to a concert with Kagura-kun
again today.)

...I kind of envy you, Kagura-kun,
getting that pumped up over
a classical concert...

K-Kagura-kun...
You've turned into a different person...

uncertain: c07466/c07467/c07475/c07477/c07486 use Deep Akihabara, which is 'provisional' in locations.json.
c07472/c07482/c07487: patoranpu (a rotating police beacon sold as a part) rendered 'police light'.

c07507: Kagura switches to a polite, old-fashioned voice (a parody of a film critic's catchphrase, 'X really is a wonderful thing'); the player's reply calls it a character change. Rendered 'Ahh, classical music truly is a wonderful thing, isn't it...' and 'You've turned into a different person...'.
c07458/c07464: the player's 'kimochi ga warui' plays on Kagura's 'kimochi ga ii' (feels great); rendered 'Well, I feel sick...'.
c07448/c07451/c07465: same line as the finished 'Today was a nice change of pace' (c04893) but with a leading ellipsis, kept.
c07470 (x3, also frd_rnk_004 male player) 'ryoukai~' rendered 'Roger~'.
